prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported whiplash. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1456; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's Narrative: On arrival at the scene in Sugar Land, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right and center lanes of the northbound roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 2 and the right front fender of Vehicle 1. Driver 1 stated that they signaled and began moving from the right lane into the center lane when Vehicle 2 moved into the same space, causing a sideswipe collision. Driver 2 stated they did not see Vehicle 1 signal and believed the other vehicle drifted over. A Passenger riding in Vehicle 1 was seated in the front passenger seat and declined medical transport at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and was evaluated by EMS, then advised to seek follow-up care. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review. Witness statements were not obtained.
